method.mapping: V(n) uses atlas floor((n-1)/16)+1, row floor(((n-1)%16)/4), column (n-1)%4.
method.boundaries: Actual pale gutter lines nearest nominal quarter divisions; no pixel gaps or overlaps.
method.gutter_detection: Pale=min(R,G,B)>=235 and max(R,G,B)-min(R,G,B)<=20; highest coverage within +/-65px of nominal division; choose central candidate within 0.005 of best coverage; require >=90% coverage and <=24px candidate spread.
method.encoding: Lossless PNG; decoded pixel values are preserved exactly.
method.runtime: Ordinary HTML img element with direct embedded PNG data URL.

diagnosis.failed_mechanism: Entire atlas PNG data URLs stored in CSS custom properties.
diagnosis.independent_ui_omission: The earlier audio library and audio dock did not insert vocabulary image elements.
